newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of Japan construction firms drop.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Japan construction firms drop.

text.p: Shares in the construction sector slipped on Monday morning, still hurt by news on Friday that general contractor Tokai Kogyo Co Ltd had decided to apply for court protection, traders said.
At 0030 GMT, shares of Tokai Kogyo were ask-only at 270 yen, down from 285 yen on Friday. The shares had been suspended from trading on Friday afternoon.
Shares of Aoki Corp fell 11 yen, or 9.24 percent, to 108 yen, making it the sharpest percentage loser on the first section. The shares briefly sank to 103 yen, a new low for this calendar year.
Shares of Tada Corp lost 19 yen, or 9.09 percent, to trade at 190, a new low for 1997. It was the second biggest percentage loser on the first section.
The third-sharpest percentage loser, Haseko Corp, fell 13 yen, or 7.88 percent, to 152. It briefly hit 150 yen, also a new low for 1997.
